c2_bad.why: Empty/loading/error state design has no bearing on D-pad key-repeat pacing on a populated rail; pulled in only for 'recommended coverage' of states.
Palette guardrail on an app the inspect step already recorded as dark-first (darkColorScheme only); restates the existing system and says nothing about the defect.
PIN gating, masking balances/medication/addresses and idle session clearing are irrelevant to a sports-rail scroll-speed bug; selected purely from the inferred environment=shared-device.

why: c2 adds tv-dpad-hold-pacing, which carries the exact fix (first press immediate, ~3-5 cards/s while held, finish each scroll step, keep the focused card at a stable position, same pace under reduced motion) that c1 lacked entirely, and it drops the three worst c1 picks (dir-broadcast-guide-tv, comp-mini-player, and the card-poster-portrait / metadata-focus-reveal direction slots that contradicted the 16:9 cards and would have hidden the very titles the user wants to read).
